description: Two different images inspired by actual private reference-library images visually reviewed on October 27. API uses derived design directions, not the competitor image pixels. Every photograph and composited layout is independently original.

tests.name: fast-dinner-hero
derived_design_principles: The thumbnail shows two close-up savory meals, warm food textures, obvious 20-minute benefit, highly contrasting headline band. Borrow an immediately legible FAST DINNER proposition and crop tightly into irresistible food; do not reproduce the original image or yellow central band.
Single-pan, believable plated chicken, clearly readable heading above imagery. Borrow the single-hero food focus with a tidy type hierarchy; create a different meal and visual angle.
tests.title: 15-MINUTE DINNERS

tests.name: family-dinner-variety
derived_design_principles: Multiple distinctly appetizing dinners offer immediate variety and a bold multi-recipe value promise. Borrow variety of meal textures and a bold central value proposition, but not the white diamond, photo quadrants or composition.
Grounded family food with familiar chicken, vegetables and dinnerware. Borrow approachable authentic home dinner appeal rather than staged luxury.
tests.title: 7 EASY FAMILY DINNERS
